best_for: People who use several AI services, or run local models, and want one desktop app on Windows, Mac or Linux to reach them all with their own API keys.
description:
Cherry Studio is a desktop AI client from CherryHQ that connects to many model providers at once: cloud services such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini, any compatible API, and local models served by Ollama or LM Studio.

Beyond plain chat, you can set up assistants with their own instructions, ask several models the same question in one conversation, build knowledge bases from files, folders and web pages, create images, translate documents and keep Markdown notes. Agents can work with files, run commands, use tools added through MCP servers or skills, and run on a schedule.

points.title: The app is free, the models are not
points.text: Cherry Studio costs nothing and is open source under the AGPL-3.0. You bring an API key from each provider and pay them for what you use, or run local models at no cost. CherryHQ also sells an optional model subscription, Cherry Flash.

points.title: Some setup before the first chat
points.text: Nothing answers until you add a model provider: open Settings, enter an API key, sync the model list and turn on a chat model. Some features also need downloaded models, extra components or system permissions, and what works depends on your provider and operating system.

points.title: Your history stays on your computer
points.text: Conversations and knowledge bases are stored on your device, with backups to a local folder or a WebDAV server. Your prompts still go to whichever cloud provider you pick, unless you use a local model.

points.title: Use at work
points.text: Commercial use is allowed under the AGPL-3.0 terms. Companies that need to be exempt from the AGPL can ask CherryHQ for a commercial license, and a separate Enterprise Edition adds central model management, shared knowledge bases and private deployment through sales.

points.title: Windows: per user or for everyone
points.text: The x64 and Arm64 Windows installers can install for the current user (`/currentuser`) or for every user of the PC (`/allusers`), and need the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 or later runtime. The Windows listing keeps 160 versions.

points.title: Mac needs Ventura or later
points.text: The Mac app comes as separate Intel and Apple silicon downloads, needs macOS 13 or later, and updates itself. macOS and Linux list only the current version, so going back on those systems needs another source.

points.title: The Linux Flatpak is not verified
points.text: On Linux this listing uses the Flathub package for x64 and Arm64, which Flathub does not mark as verified. CherryHQ's own Linux downloads are .deb, .rpm and AppImage files.
